item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On 30 August 2023 in Goma, security forces confronted a banned protest by Wazalendo followers against MONUSCO and other international organizations. A local civil-society official reported 26 civilians killed and at least 50 injured; protesters accused the army of firing live rounds, while the army said protesters stoned a policeman to death and reported 160 arrests.","notes":["The excerpt attributes the live-round allegation to protesters, not the army."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Tshisekedi invited social actors to address children living in the street and recommended a national child-protection strategy and a framework for concrete, effective, and durable family, social, and economic reintegration, with government and partner support.","notes":["The excerpt says he invited and recommended these measures; it does not establish that he directed their implementation."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In April 2023, Tshisekedi announced pre-cantonment and disarmament of M23 elements at Kitshanga, followed by transfer to a site being developed near Goma for cantonment and preparation for integration into the PDDRCS; he also said he had observed delays in M23 withdrawal and supported regional diplomatic initiatives.","notes":["The excerpt places the planned site near Goma, not near Kindu."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E010","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Tshisekedi's PDL-145T was presented as a publicly financed program, with partner support, intended to reduce poverty and spatial inequalities through health centers, primary schools, and administrative buildings. Three implementing agencies were expected to begin delivering infrastructure in July 2023, with planned financing of $300 million for 2021, $700 million for 2022, and $660.1 million for 2023, totaling approximately $1.66 billion.","notes":["The excerpt states public financing with support from technical and financial partners, not exclusively national funding."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
